scope: buy-then-sell spot-roundtrip received-inventory limit; not autonomous ledger migration or sell-then-buy cash budgeting

implementation.native_fee_policy: Complete reconciled fill rows with nonnegative native commissions; subtract only base-asset commissions. No inferred commission when rows or fields are missing. No third-asset conversion or rebate inventory credit.
implementation.nonterminal_partial: Stop before resale while first order can still fill.
implementation.quantity_policy: Minimum of validated net received quantity and available balance, floored to eight wire decimals before normalization; reject normalization or wire rounding above that limit.

verification.note: The JUnit file covers the 100-case domain run; the three later terminal-partial cases and one entrypoint check are separate passing runs. All exchange behavior was stubbed.

source_hash_convention: UTF-8 bytes with CRLF normalized to LF; preserve BOM. Hashes bind this source revision, not a claim that all lines of the large files were reviewed.
reviewed_production_boundaries: cli.py::command_spot_roundtrip receipt routing and partial-failure handling
remaining: Autonomous openings still project gross quantity and modeled fees; native gross/net migration must integrate original intent validation rather than silently replacing quantity.
Direct CLI write-ahead obligations, account identity, explicit crash recovery/rearm and independent supervision remain unfinished.
The opposite sell-then-buy branch retains its existing wallet-based cash sizing; this patch does not prove it self-financing.
Returned receipt is assumed bound to the submitted order by the existing shared API validator; this helper is not a substitute for that binding.
Exit fees, quote/BNB valuation, exact net PnL, filters and slippage remain separate boundaries.

financial_research.discovery_note: Four targeted search queries did not establish a new qualifying Launchpool campaign. A USDC 8-percent / 10000-cap headline resolved in discovery to a 2025-10-10 through 2025-11-08 offer. Search is not exhaustive availability proof and no economic input or current rate was admitted.
